allowedWrites: Graphify final-certification artifacts regenerated by the existing certification tool

futureWorkspace.sourceWorkspace: the existing Lamha repository checkout; never a clone, worktree, backup, archive, or duplicate source tree
rootConstraints: resolved root is absolute and canonical
resolved root is outside and not an ancestor of the Lamha repository
resolved root is not a symlink, junction, or reparse point
packageId and runId identify one authorized run
the run root is empty or newly created when the authorized run begins
no repository source tree is copied into the run root
commandRules: Every output-producing command must belong to the separately authorized package and run.
Every build, test, cache, generated, package-manager, and temporary path must resolve below its declared output-class path.
Tool environment variables and command flags must redirect all writable outputs before execution.
If a tool cannot prove complete redirection, that command is forbidden.
Intentional source edits remain package-authorized source changes and must never be disguised as generated output.
The invoking package must compare repository state before and after execution and report every unexpected path as failure.

forbiddenLocations: Codebase/** except separately authorized intentional source edits
graphify/** except the current package evidence and existing certification outputs
any parent or ancestor of the Lamha repository
any symlink, junction, or reparse-point target
forbiddenOperations: silent fallback to an in-repository output path

failurePolicy.behavior: reject before command execution with a typed error and preserve authoritative state
